name: 43235 · Columbus, OH
findings: ZIP 43235 (Columbus) has 198 nonprofit organizations. 113 of them (57%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 92 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43235 (Columbus) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
